question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The show played to full houses for a five-night run and ended to _______ applause on Saturday night.
solution:
The correct answer is "**tumultuous**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The blank in the given sentence will imply how the applause for the show was loud and noisy.**
 
• **Among the given options, the correct word to use in the blank is "tumultuous."**
 
 
• **Tumultuous means loud, confused, and disorderly.**(अंशातिप्रिय)
 
 
• Example: "There was tumultuous applause as he rose to speak
 
 
 
• It is often used to describe a noisy or chaotic situation.
 
 
 
• In this context, tumultuous applause means the audience was cheering loudly and enthusiastically.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1) redress means to correct or make something right. It does not make sense in this context.(निवारण)
 
• Option 2) barren means unproductive or empty. It does not make sense in this context.(अनुपजाऊ)
 
• Option 3) semantic relates to the meaning of words. It does not make sense in this context.(अर्थ)
